summary: Baltic Fresh Foods Ltd. presented its Q3 2026 Operations Report prepared by COO Helena Lindqvist. The company generated revenue of EUR 4,850,000 against operating costs of EUR 3,920,000 during the quarter. Key operational achievements included high cold-chain utilisation, retiring two legacy depots, and migrating route planning to a new telematics platform. Additionally, capital expenditure reached USD 310,000, and partner Northern Cold Chain AB extended their framework agreement until 2028.
keyPoints: Q3 2026 revenue reached EUR 4,850,000 with operating costs of EUR 3,920,000.
Cold-chain utilisation stayed above target throughout the quarter.
Migration of route planning to the new telematics platform was completed.
Northern Cold Chain AB extended the framework agreement until 2028.
Capital expenditure amounted to USD 310,000, primarily for sensors and electric vans.
